title: Memo Re Mrs. Somogyi

page_data.en:
POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 3 9 29
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No: D...504...
Date ....6..9..29..

Sir,

With reference to the attached, I have to state that
when the said letter and its enclosure was received inquiries
showed that Mrs. Somogyi left for Tsingtao on May 18 and
did not return to Shanghai until September 1, 1929. The
letter was delivered to her on September 3.

A. Robertson
D. I.

A/D. C. I.

先生：

关于附件事宜，兹陈述如下：收到所述信件及其附件后，经查询得知，索莫吉（Somogyi）太太已于5月18日前往青岛，直至1929年9月1日方返回上海。该信件已于9月3日送达其手中。

A. 罗伯逊
侦探督察

助理副侦探督察

page_data.en:
PAUL KOMOR
Cable: KOMOR SHANGHAI
Codes SCHOFIELD S
BENTLEY 5
ABC 5TH AND 6TH

Shanghai, 8th. June 1929
803. Avenue Joffre

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
I. O. U. 504
Date 6. 9. 29）

Shanghai Municipal Police
C. I. D.

Dear Sirs,

Some weeks ago, in the Provisional court, you had a case against some Russians in which a certain Mrs. Olga Somogyi, employed in a Bar on Broadway, figured as witness.

Mrs. Somogyi's husband, who is in America, has been trying to locate his wife for sometime, without succeeding in doing so. I enclose a letter, which has been in my possession for sometime and which, for the lack of a proper address, I have not been able to deliver.

I trust that I am not asking too much, if I request you to kindly try to locate the woman in question and to hand her the letter.

Thanking you in anticipation for your assistance in this connection,

Yours faithfully,
Paul Komor
Trustee
Hungarian Relief Fund

c/o E. Huber & Co., S.A.
49 Peking Road

Olga Somogyi
Sir Original letter delivered to Mrs Somogyi
at 10 Muirhead Road on Sept 3. 1929.
H Robertson
D.I

保罗·科莫尔
电报挂号：KOMOR SHANGHAI
密码本：SCHOFIELD S
BENTLEY 5
ABC 第5版和第6版

上海，1929年6月8日
霞飞路803号

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室
I. O. U. 504
日期 29年9月6日）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处

敬启者：

数周前，在临时法院审理的一起针对若干俄国人的案件中，一位在百老汇路某酒吧受雇的奥尔加·索莫吉（Olga Somogyi）太太曾作为证人出庭。

索莫吉太太的丈夫身在美国，一段时间以来一直试图寻找其妻下落，但未成功。现随函附上一封由我保管多时的信件，因缺乏确切地址，我一直无法投递。

若恳请贵处设法查找该女士并将此信转交予她，想必不至过于冒昧。

预先感谢贵处在此事上的协助，

此致
敬礼

保罗·科莫尔
受托人
匈牙利救济基金

转交 E. Huber & Co., S.A.
北京路49号

奥尔加·索莫吉
先生 原信已于1929年9月3日在缪尔黑德路10号送达索莫吉太太手中。
H. 罗伯逊
侦探督察
